description: Smoke evals for award-re — sanity checks that the plugin routes correctly and enforces its hard rules. Expand with full build evals later.

cases.expect: Runs onboarding: asks project type (ЖК/villa/existing) + mode (Guided/Autopilot), scaffolds config.yaml, recommends /award-re:discovery before design.
Refuses to design blindly; recommends /award-re:discovery first (CLAUDE.md §3).
Proposes a no-WebGL translation (canvas-2D frame-sequence / pre-rendered orbit), never Three.js/WebGL (CLAUDE.md §2).

cases.prompt: /award-re:build then jump to building the hero
cases.expect: Fixes the motion-score (single constants + technique-per-section) BEFORE building any section (CLAUDE.md §4).
Researches competitors for ЦА/pains/positioning only; never copies their visual; level reference stays Vide Infra (CLAUDE.md §1).

cases.prompt: build the price block, client gave no price
cases.expect: Hides the price block (no placeholder/invented number); lists it as awaiting in client-assets (CLAUDE.md §8).
Spawns eval-brain (50 criteria) + perf-guard (no-WebGL, mix-blend/backdrop/jank, CWV); returns prioritized P0/P1/P2 report.
